content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Explain the role of ADH in water balance
Describe the negative feedback mechanism controlling water balance
Explain how the kidneys produce concentrated or dilute urine

The body must maintain a constant water balance. Too much water dilutes body fluids; too little causes dehydration. The kidneys regulate water balance by controlling how much water is reabsorbed. This is controlled by the hormone
